quarterly_data.quarter: 3M IR presentation: Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year EPS (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, segment and outlook detail: Q3 adjusted operating income by segment was Safety & Industrial $960 million (30.1% margin, organic +7.0%), Transportation & Electronics $468 million (23.4%, organic +0.5%) and Consumer $300 million (23.0%, organic -0.2%). Electronics end-market view: H1 '+Strong DD' in semiconductors and data centers and -LSD in consumer electronics, H2 '+Stronger DD' versus '-Mid-teens', with weak consumer electronics and industry-wide memory shortages cited; Q3 China sales were down HSD due to weakness in consumer electronics. 3M launched 87 new products in Q3 (up 24%) and has closed or exited 16 sites year to date, with 10 more over the next 12 months. Medium-term commitments (2025-2027) are an operating margin of ~25.4% by 2027 on the new basis and $13.5B to $14.0B of free cash flow; 2025 actuals restated on the new amortization basis are 23.9% operating margin and $8.20 EPS.
quarterly_data.figure: S&I operating margin 30.1%; T&E 23.4%; 2027 operating margin commitment ~25.4%; FCF $13.5B to $14.0B (2025-2027)
